scripts.title: Cuts Every Tree In the game automatically
scripts.features: Automatically chops every tree in the game with a short delay
scripts.script:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Signal = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Signal"):WaitForChild("Tree")

local TreesFolder = workspace

local HIT_DELAY = 0.1

for _, obj in pairs(TreesFolder:GetDescendants()) do
	if obj:IsA("Model") and string.find(obj.Name, "World 1_") then
		task.spawn(function()
			while obj.Parent do
				Signal:FireServer("damage", obj.Name)
				task.wait(HIT_DELAY)
			end
		end)
	end
end

scripts.script:

local CodeScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")

ArrowBtn.Font = FontBold
ArrowBtn.TextScaled = true

ScriptsFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Black
ScriptsFrame.BorderSizePixel = 3
ScriptsFrame.BorderColor3 = Lime
ScriptsFrame.Visible = false
ScriptsFrame.Parent = SidePanel

local scriptsList = {
    {name = "1. Fly GUI", code = 'loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastebin.com/raw/9kTfJ9W2"))()'},
    {name = "2. Fling", code = 'loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Touch-fling-script-22447"))()'},
    {name = "3. Invisible", code = 'loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastebin.com/raw/vP6CrQJj"))()'},
    {name = "4. Admin", code = 'loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Nameless-admin-reworked-75477"))()'},
    {name = "5. Ghost", code = 'loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Danster206/Ghost-Hub-Danster206-/refs/heads/main/Ghost%20Hub.lua"))()'},
    {name = "6. Troll", code = 'loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastefy.app/rmdi1m55/raw"))()'},
    {name = "7. Emotes", code = 'loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://scriptblox.com/raw/Brookhaven-RP-all-emotes-6849"))()'},
    {name = "8. Roblox Egor", code = 'loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GithubMagical/Roblox-Egor/refs/heads/main/lua%20v2", true))()'}
}

local column1 = {}
local column2 = {}

for i, scriptData in ipairs(scriptsList) do
    if i <= 4 then
        table.insert(column1, scriptData)
    else
        table.insert(column2, scriptData)
    end
end

local yOffset1 = 20
for i, scriptData in ipairs(column1) do
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.43, 0, 0, 40)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, yOffset1)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Black
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 3
    btn.BorderColor3 = Lime
    btn.Text = scriptData.name
    btn.TextColor3 = Lime
    btn.Font = FontBold
    btn.TextScaled = true
    btn.Parent = ScriptsFrame
    
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            loadstring(scriptData.code)()
        end)
        if not success then
            warn("Ошибка в " .. scriptData.name .. ": " .. tostring(err))
        end
    end)
    
    yOffset1 = yOffset1 + 90
end

local yOffset2 = 20
for i, scriptData in ipairs(column2) do
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.43, 0, 0, 40)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.54, 0, 0, yOffset2)  
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Black
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 3
    btn.BorderColor3 = Lime
    btn.Text = scriptData.name
    btn.TextColor3 = Lime
    btn.Font = FontBold
    btn.TextScaled = true
    btn.Parent = ScriptsFrame
    
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            loadstring(scriptData.code)()
        end)
        if not success then
            warn("Ошибка в " .. scriptData.name .. ": " .. tostring(err))
        end
    end)
    
    yOffset2 = yOffset2 + 90
end

local PanelOpen = false

ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    PanelOpen = not PanelOpen
    MainFrame.Visible = PanelOpen
    SidePanel.Visible = PanelOpen
    ScriptsFrame.Visible = false
    ArrowBtn.Text = "←"
    ToggleBtn.Text = PanelOpen and "Close" or "Open"
end)

ArrowBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ScriptsFrame.Visible = not ScriptsFrame.Visible
    ArrowBtn.Text = ScriptsFrame.Visible and "→" or "←"
end)

local function executeCode()
    local code = CodeBox.Text
    if code == "" or code:match("^%s*$") then return end
    
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        loadstring(code)()
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Executor error: " .. tostring(err))
    end
end

ExecBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(executeCode)
ClearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() CodeBox.Text = "" end)
CodeBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter) if enter then executeCode() end end)
